verdict.rationale: Statsig documents one first-party data export: Warehouse Native exports daily deduplicated first-exposure rollups to the customer's own warehouse, where analysis runs directly on customer-owned data. No general 'export all my data' feature is documented, and the open formats used are not stated. The Console API's JSON CRUD access to configs is a developer building block, not a documented export, so it earns no credit. missing for 10: documented full-account export covering events, metrics, configs and experiment results; explicit open export formats; migration/offboarding guidance; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Statsig calculates deduplicated first-exposure rollups for you on a daily basis and exports that miniaturized dataset to your warehouse.
You can use any of these features on top of your own data warehouse through [Warehouse Native](/en/statsig-warehouse-native/introduction) with no extract, transform, and load (ETL).
Statsig Warehouse Native is an experimentation platform that runs analysis directly in your data warehouse.
